description: This file contains the implementation of serialization and copying logic for List<T> in the Orleans framework, including ListCodec<T> for serialization, ListCopier<T> for deep copying, and related supporting code.

classes.name: ListCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer for List<T> that handles serialization and deserialization of list data streams, including reference tracking and length encoding.

classes.name: ListCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier for List<T>, capable of creating deep copies of list instances with support for reference tracking within the serialization context.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a List<T> to the writer, including list length and elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a List<T> from the reader, reconstructing the list from wire format.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the List<T> content by writing length and each element.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Reads from the wire to populate a List<T> with deserialized data.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a List<T>, copying each element.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies data from input list to output list, with deep copying of elements.
